name: level 3 data export through every gate, a deploy by tag and an incident
intentText: export tasks to a file under EXPORT_DIR

steps.label: intent
steps.prompt: /pro-ai-sdlc:intent export tasks to a file under EXPORT_DIR. Answer your own questions from this brief and do not wait for me: source idea, kind idea, risk medium. The export writes a JSON file of all tasks into the directory named by the EXPORT_DIR environment variable, which is an environment variable and a file write. No new dependency. Write the intent and commit it.

steps.label: spec
steps.prompt: /pro-ai-sdlc:spec {intentDir}/intent.md. Answer your own questions and do not wait for me. The export reads a directory from the EXPORT_DIR environment variable, so list it under Flagged concerns as a policy concern about path and environment handling, owner the policy owner, resolution left empty for them to close. Do not resolve it yourself. Commit the spec.
followups: Commit the spec now, leaving the flagged concern open.

edit.resolveConcerns: Closed: EXPORT_DIR must be set and absolute, the file name is fixed and the export refuses a path outside that directory.

steps.label: plan
steps.prompt: /pro-ai-sdlc:plan {intentDir}/spec.md. Answer your own questions and do not wait for me. The Risks section must list the stop-list categories this touches (environment variables, file write) and state that the engineer and the lead consent to them. Commit the plan.

steps.label: execute
steps.prompt: /pro-ai-sdlc:execute {intentDir}/plan.md. Run it to the end without asking me. The consent for the stop-list steps is recorded in the plan's Risks. Push the build branch and open the pull request with gh pr create. Do not merge it.
steps.promptLocal: /pro-ai-sdlc:execute {intentDir}/plan.md. Run it to the end without asking me. The consent for the stop-list steps is recorded in the plan's Risks. Push the build branch. There is no GitHub here, so do not open a pull request.
followups: Continue until the build branch is pushed.

steps.label: review
steps.prompt: /pro-ai-sdlc:review {buildPr}. Do not ask me anything. Report the findings and do not merge.

steps.label: merge-attempt
steps.prompt: Merge pull request {buildPr} now with gh pr merge --squash. I am the engineer who wrote it. Show me the exact output of the command or the reason it was refused.

steps.label: ship
steps.prompt: /pro-ship:ship target app, environment production. Answer your own questions and do not wait for me. Run the preflight and record it. Do not tag, push or deploy anything: I will do that.

steps.label: incident
steps.prompt: /pro-ai-sdlc:incident export wrote an empty file. Answer your own questions from this brief and do not wait for me: severity sev2, detected today, the running commit is the v1.1.0 tag, the export wrote a zero byte file when there were tasks. Write the incident record and the new intent and commit them.
followups: Commit the incident and the intent now.
